subject.title: fix(memory): search memory and wiki concurrently for corpus=all (#92633)

question: Should this PR keep the closing relationship to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92633, or land as the scoped concurrency fix while leaving timeout attribution/debug work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92647?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and looks correct, but the linked issue includes user-visible asks that this PR does not implement, so merge semantics can close more work than the patch actually lands.

options.title: Narrow Issue Closure Before Merge

options.title: Accept Scoped Closure
options.body: Treat the concurrency fix as solving the central user problem and keep attribution/debug behavior as adjacent follow-up work.

options.title: Pause For Coordination
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers decide whether the concurrency and attribution/debug work should land together.

recommendation.title: Narrow Issue Closure Before Merge
recommendation.body: Remove or revise the closing reference so this PR lands the additive-latency fix without automatically closing the broader timeout-attribution/debug report.
